a.lede: AMD's Lux supercomputer debuted at position 14 on the new TOP500 list published during SC26. It's one of two machines AMD is developing as part of a $1 billion deal with the U.S. Department of Energy.
a.title: AMD grabs over 40% of new TOP500 list for supercomputers, up 14% since last year

b.lede: AI has birthed some truly colossal supers, they just aren't on the Top500
b.title: To rank the world's biggest supercomputers, we're gonna need a bigger bench
